'''5-A''' was the personal [[StealthX]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] of [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] held within the Master's Hangar of the [[Temple of the Sith|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Master Skywalker traveled to [[Hesperidium/Legends|Hesperidium]] and to [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] in order to destroy [[Lumiya]] and later [[Darth Caedus]].
